basic_info.description: Nestled in a boutique 4-unit building, this top-floor 2BR/1.5BA condo with a separate entrance and private garage offers an incredible opportunity to own a home that's about to shine even brighter! The building is undergoing major exterior renovations, including new windows and partial siding, which will enhance its curb appeal and long-term value. While temporarily covered in scaffolding, the photos showcase its pristine condition before renovations began. Best of all, these upgrades will be paid for by the seller from the sale proceeds, offering added value to the future owner. Located in the heart of the city near USF, Koret Sports Center, Golden Gate Park, NOPA's dining scene, corporate shuttles, bike routes, and public transitwith easy access to 101 and the Golden Gate Bridge. Step inside this light-filled home, where timeless classic details meet modern comfort. The entry foyer leads to a bright living room with Twin Peaks views, a formal dining room, and a remodeled custom kitchen. Hardwood floors, crown molding, recessed lighting, and ample closets add charm and functionality. A private garage, storage room, laundry area, shared garden, and patio complete this unique home. With improvements underway, now is the perfect time to invest before it reaches its full potential.
